svg.title: D8 control section of the RF box
svg.desc: DIP switch bank that sets the 6-bit parallel word of the digital attenuator, the TTL gate input for the RF switch and the connector tables.
svg.text: D8 RF box, part 2: attenuator DIP switches, TTL gate input and the cables
Attenuator ZX76-31R5-PN-S+: 6 parallel bits, latch enable LE tied high = the attenuation follows the switches at once (direct mode, per the datasheet).
A six-way DIP bank, one per attenuator
R3 to R8: 10 kΩ pull-downs. Switch ON = this bit adds its dB (logic 1).
Power-up: set all six ON = 31.5 dB, the safe state.
DC pins on the module: P1 GND, P2 Vdd (+3.0 V), P3 GND, P4 Vss (−3.1 V).
Solder them fast: the pins overheat (Mini-Circuits AN-40-010).
B TTL gate input of one RF switch (ZASWA-2-50DR+)
HIGH (2–5 V): OUT 1 off, OUT 2 on
LOW (0–0.8 V): OUT 1 on, OUT 2 off
We use OUT 2 for the AOM:
gate HIGH = RF on. 50 Ω on OUT 1.
C Wiring of the RF chain (all RF on SMA, 50 Ω; the DC and control wires in the box)
Switch ZASWA-2-50DR+: RF IN = pin 1, OUT 1 = pin 3, OUT 2 = pin 6, TTL IN = pin 4, +5 V = pin 2, −5 V = pin 5. All RF connections must be DC blocked
Attenuator ZX76-31R5-PN-S+: RF in J2, RF out J3, control J1, supplies P1–P4 as above. Insertion loss at 0 dB: 1.5 dB typ (2.2 dB max), input limit
Amplifier ZHL-1-2W-S+ (SMA, with heatsink, 700 g): +24 V on its feed-through, 0.9 A; input limit +10 dBm; output to the coupler, never open.
Coupler ZFDC-20-4-S+: IN from the amplifier, OUT to the AOM, CPL (−19.5 dB) to a scope input with a 50 Ω feed-through terminator. Power limit 2 W.
Order: synthesizer → switch (IN 1, OUT 2) → attenuator → amplifier → coupler → AOM. Cables: SMA male-male 0.3–0.5 m, same on both arms.
Label each arm A or B on every box and cable, and keep a log of the attenuator setting that gave the best efficiency.
DIP bank + pull-downs (attenuator), 100 Ω + 10 kΩ at the gate input (switch). Test: gate the RF and look at the coupler on the scope.
